svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two from 3 mm PVC foam board, each 528 wide x 218 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a U 168 wide, centred, from 20 up off the bottom edge to the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The core's 180 wide end then overlaps the U by 6 each side and 6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the bottom; stick 3 mm foam gasket tape round the U on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outdoor frame only: a 13 hole 40 left of centre (as seen from the room;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drawn here as seen from outdoors), 6 up, for the drain tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the floor lining, glued to the side lining with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: contact adhesive, 300 apart (inside faces) so the core fits

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between them; the lid's foam block closes the U above the core.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the core drops between the frames without force and both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends bear on the gasket all round the U.
